what_this_is_en: Every chemical substance named on every line of CN109678767A, read straight off the English text and asked only that: not roles, not quantities, not whether the substance matters. `specific` names one substance you could draw; `generic` refers to a substance without naming one, and is kept apart because `the catalyst` is sometimes only an anaphor and sometimes the finding itself.
verified_en: Every span below was checked mechanically to be a literal substring, character for character, of the English line it is filed under, before this file was written.
